title: Map Your Recovery Signals
subtitle: Turn this week's ideas into information you can use.
description: There are no right or wrong answers. Notice what tends to increase concern and what helps you feel more confident, supported, or able to participate.

sections.title: What increases concern?
sections.description: Think about situations—not just symptoms—that can make recovery feel harder.

fields.label: Which factors have mattered recently?
options: Avoiding activity because it feels unsafe

fields.label: What else tends to increase concern or make symptoms harder to manage?
fields.placeholder: Describe a situation, thought, sensation, or pattern you have noticed...

sections.title: What builds confidence?
sections.description: Identify resources that help you feel safer or more capable—not necessarily symptom-free.

fields.label: Which could support you?
options: Rest or a change of pace
Remembering progress I have already made

fields.label: What is one confidence-building action you can try this week?

successMessage: Your recovery signals map is complete. Use it as a starting point—not a fixed rule—and revisit these questions as you learn more.
